newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC wants higher output, lower costs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC wants higher output, lower costs.

text.p: Gold and nickel miner WMC Ltd said on Wednesday that it aimed to achieve higher nickel and gold production, along with lower costs, in the current year.

The company also said in its 1995/96 annual report that it planned this year to finalise agreements and begin feasibility studies for the development of the Zarmitan gold project in Uzbekistan and its Cuban nickel deposits.
WMC also said it would utilise the funds to be raised from the sale of its petroleum assets, which were put for sale in late August.

On September 5, the company said it achieved a 20.4 percent rise in 1995/96 equity-accounted net profit to A$386.2 million and forecast flat to higher production of its key commidities this financial year.
